description: This source file implements a C++ client for an IPC (Inter-Process Communication) service using protobuf and custom IPC channels. It demonstrates connecting to a server socket, subscribing to events, making RPC calls with responses, no-reply calls, and file descriptor passing, as well as managing event loops and threading.

methods.name: onSomeEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when a 'SomeEvent' is received from the server, prints the event details.

methods.name: onComplete
methods.description: Callback to mark completion of an RPC call.

methods.name: runChannelEventLoop
methods.description: Function running in a thread to process IPC channel events until disconnection.
